dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' and 'C' shaped light-pigmented structures along the dorsal-lateral surface. The most prominent structures exhibit a high-contrast transition from a dark-brown perimeter to a light-tan center, particularly a cluster of three circular annuli located on the mid-dorsal ridge which show well-defined, sharp geometric boundaries.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of solid, high-intensity light-tan pixel clusters concentrated on the lower lateral flank and shoulder region. These clusters are asymmetrical, lack internal gradients, and appear as a dense, overlapping field of non-uniform splotches.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Geometric relationships formed by the centroids of the three prominent dorsal annuli create an obtuse triangle. A secondary spatial relationship exists between these dorsal centroids and the densest concentration of lateral blobs, forming an elongated, irregular polygonal pattern along the mid-body axis.
